repair: Recover malformed tool arguments and persist encrypted event journals before dispatch. Precreate the read-only Node dependency mountpoint; reject selector infrastructure failures; preserve all authoritative tests and fixed expected counts. Task inputs, source catalog, model, budgets and selection contract are unchanged.
native_skill_delivery: explicit skill input items and a read-only /skills mirror for full upstream files or exact selected paragraphs; actual source loading is verified by a probe
rule: A completion advantage over direct skills must repeat on the same task, with no baseline/direct completion regression. Otherwise no repeated completion advantage. Failures and scope violations remain failures; instrument failures invalidate conclusions.
performance_rule: Two repeats only: descriptive usage and timings; no general efficiency claim.
overhead: Include both task selectors, skill publication, fresh native auth/context/catalog, all tool calls, workspace creation, authoritative grading, candidate-test counterfactuals and cleanup. Account shared source acquisition separately. Do not represent unknown human research, integration, maintenance or prototype development effort as zero.
shared_preexisting_setup: Already installed local Python and Node dependencies. No fresh-machine install or model download measured.
